name: QWEN-LOOP-STATE-0
note: Mechanical projection of PRE-REG QWEN-LOOP-STATE-0 (RESULTS, 2026-08-20). Transcribed alongside the RESULTS registration, before any run; bars verbatim. Capture sets, anchors, and preconditions derived from the FROZEN autopsy sidecars logs/qweneffort2_probe/traj_xhigh_{0,3,4}.json.

BLe.description: BLe on qcuda-tower, xhigh cell, greedy observation-only regen of items 0/4 (primary exact orbits) + 3 (semantic-restart contrast), sparse fp32 pre-head h capture at frozen positions

capture.event_color: first frozen-detector fire per item, +/-16, descriptive only

preconditions.P2_capture_fixture: first 8 captured positions per item, bit-exact: top1 identical all 24 AND max abs logit diff == 0.0

bars.name: INTERNAL-ORBIT
bars.aggregation: median per item, min over items
bars.description: median cosine(h_p, h_{p+kL}) >= 0.99 in BOTH items 0 and 4

bars.name: STUCK-RETRY-POLICY
bars.description: top1 identical fraction >= 0.80 AND median full-vocab JS (fp64, natural log) <= 0.05 nats; both clauses must hold

refuted_if: bar 1 median cosine < 0.90 on EITHER item 0 or 4: tokens recur without internal-state recurrence, killing the internal-attractor reading
registered_prior: bar 1 FIRES with medians > 0.999 on both items; bar 2 FIRES on both clauses
